Haiti was the first independent republic in the Western Hemisphere to grant women rights.

Statistically, this has been an accurate description of women’s treatment in Haiti.
According to the American Red Cross, Haiti ranked among the ten countries in the world in terms of empowerment of women.
(Red Cross 2007)
The empowerment of women in Haiti has been seen in several ways.

sentences.sentence: aims at maximizing its profits to the point of neglecting the welfare of its customers and the society at large is likely to have negative consequences.
The main stakeholders of a business include the customers, employees, shareholders and the government (Scherer 2009).
A business that neglects the welfare of its customers is likely to lose its reputation.
The government is likely to introduce laws that regulate the operation of the business in question to protect its customers and the society at large.
The business will, therefore, need to change the approach it takes to the welfare of its customers.
Objectives of Business
The success of any business, whether a small or large enterprise, depends on its objectives.
A business could be established to manufacture a particular product or provide a specific service.
Regardless of the objective, there are several business objectives that every business seeks to achieve (Tufekci 2005).
In addition to the object of making profit, businesses have objectives of providing customer satisfaction and increasing the value of the company to its stakeholders (Zollo & Winter 2004).
Therefore, any business that is established with the sole purpose of making profit is likely to fail because it does not have the other objectives as mentioned above.
A business that fails to satisfy its customers and the government is likely to fail.
Role of Ethics in Achieving Business Objectives
While most businesses focus on making profit, the success of a business in the long run depends on the level of customer satisfaction.
The customers are the most important stakeholders of a business.
Customers are the ones who use the products manufactured and services provided by the business.
As a result, they form a significant component of the business operations (Palmquist 2006).
If a business does not have ethics and values that promote the satisfaction of customers, it is likely to lose the customers it already has and also attract more customers who are loyal to brands.

Google has grown to become more than an Internet search engine.
It is now a business that deals with online search results, which are processed through the company’s massive computing power.
It is a tool that helps people accomplish a variety of tasks.
The engine is used by businesses and individuals as a tool for finding out information, learning things, and completing various tasks.
Google also deals with other services such as web hosting, advertising, and cloud computing.
In 2009, the company launched Wolfram Alpha, which was designed as a search engine for math equations.
The engine works by computing all the information it needs and providing it to the user.
Its core function is finding numerical and quantitative solutions.
The goal of the Wolfram Alpha is to help researchers find the answers they need, which in the field of research is very important.
It is designed as a replacement for many existing search engines, like Google.
It may be used in the same way as a search engine, or it may be accessed by people who are looking for scientific formulas, numerical statistics, dates, and more.
The company created the engine because it had an interest in helping people and researchers in their work with complex numerical information.
Wolfram Alpha was made to replace all the other existing search engines, including Google.
It was created to help mathematicians and researchers find the answers they need faster and more efficiently.

In the United States, zip codes are groups of five digits used for geographical identification and used to determine the location of a physical place and to address mail sent to that location.
They were introduced in 1963 as the area code and the zone of the ZIP code.
Later, they became the official name for the United States Postal Service and also came to be used as a way of identifying places in the United States.
Zip codes are often assigned to a specific group, such as people living in an apartment building or a neighborhood.
Due to the differences in their location, people can have similar characteristics, but their social status, income, and even health can be different.
Such differences may be related to their social position as well as to their race or gender, but they also depend on their zip codes.
This is why the social impact of zip codes on human health should be studied.
The primary argument for studying the social impact of zip codes is that there is a substantial difference in social status between zip codes.
Some researchers have identified a relationship between the socioeconomic status of a neighborhood and the quality of a life in it.
For example, a higher-income community is more likely to have higher-quality housing and more parks and schools.
The higher population density in the more affluent areas also contributes to the differences.
The more expensive homes also tend to have higher levels of education for their inhabitants and better access to transportation.

They were introduced in 1963 as the area code and the zone of the ZIP code.
Later, they became the official name for the United States Postal Service and also came to be used as a way of identifying places in the United States.
Zip codes are often assigned to a specific group, such as people living in an apartment building or a neighborhood.
Due to the differences in their location, people can have similar characteristics, but their social status, income, and even health can be different.
Such differences may be related to their social position as well as to their race or gender, but they also depend on their zip codes.
This is why the social impact of zip codes on human health should be studied.
The primary argument for studying the social impact of zip codes is that there is a substantial difference in social status between zip codes.
Some researchers have identified a relationship between the socioeconomic status of a neighborhood and the quality of a life in it.
For example, a higher-income community is more likely to have higher-quality housing and more parks and schools.
The higher population density in the more affluent areas also contributes to the differences.
The more expensive homes also tend to have higher levels of education for their inhabitants and better access to transportation.
